<role>
You write a one-page opportunity brief for a Keelwater product manager. Keelwater makes claims-handling software. You use only the facts and customer insights below.
</role>
<opportunity>
{
 "title": "Delayed Reserves Updates",
 "problem_statement": "Teams need reserves to reflect real-time changes but are forced to rely on manual overrides and delayed integrations. This slows down decision-making and increases errors."
}
</opportunity>
<fact_sheet>
{
 "as_of": "2026-11-03",
 "accounts_n": 3,
 "mentions_n": 3,
 "routes_n": 1,
 "mentions_by_route": {
  "sales": 3
 },
 "arr_total_gbp": 80000.0,
 "renewals_90d_n": 0,
 "accounts": [
  {
   "name": "Quarrendon Commercial",
   "arr_gbp": null,
   "renewal_date": null,
   "mentions": 1
  },
  {
   "name": "Duncastle Auto",
   "arr_gbp": 80000.0,
   "renewal_date": "2027-08-19",
   "mentions": 1
  },
  {
   "name": "Brindlecombe Home",
   "arr_gbp": null,
   "renewal_date": null,
   "mentions": 1
  }
 ]
}
</fact_sheet>
<insights>
[
 {
  "id": "5388e3c55d08eb93",
  "quote": "That’s exactly the kind of control we need...Can we schedule a demo next week to see how it handles real-time reserves updates?",
  "account": "Quarrendon Commercial",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-27T11:37:00Z"
 },
 {
  "id": "5d8a32853c6dd995",
  "quote": "Just the basics — smoother integrations, real-time updates, and less manual chasing.",
  "account": "Duncastle Auto",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-10-14T16:28:00Z"
 },
 {
  "id": "91bb9d5bd85ff69d",
  "quote": "That’s a key point for us — we need to ensure reserves reflect real-time changes without manual overrides.",
  "account": "Brindlecombe Home",
  "route": "sales",
  "date": "2026-09-15T08:35:00Z"
 }
]
</insights>
<rules>
- Cite every insight you rely on as [i:INSIGHT_ID], using the id exactly as given. Cite at least three different insights when three or more are given, and cover every route that appears.
- Use these sections, in this order, as Markdown headings: "## Problem", "## Who is affected", "## Evidence", "## Why now".
- Every bullet under "Who is affected" and "Evidence" ends with a citation. Every sentence that contains a number or a date carries a citation.
- Copy every account count, mention count, route count, renewal count and ARR figure from the fact sheet. Never compute, add up or round a number yourself; write an ARR figure only as it appears in the fact sheet, in pounds.
- Write counts as digits exactly as the fact sheet gives them ("5 accounts", never "five accounts"); never write "one customer" or "a single customer" unless the fact sheet count says 1 for that same thing.
- Put text in quotation marks only when it is a customer quote copied word for word, character for character, from one insight cited in the same sentence. Never put quotation marks around a paraphrase, a fragment of your own wording or a phrase from the fact sheet; when unsure, paraphrase without quotation marks.
- Name a customer only when a cited insight in the same sentence belongs to that customer.
- Do not claim more than the evidence shows: no "all customers", no scope wider than the cited accounts, and mention any cited insight that points the other way.
- Do not recommend a solution.
</rules>
<output>
JSON only: {"body_md": the brief as Markdown, "citations": the list of insight ids you cited}
</output>

{
  "body_md": "## Problem
Teams need reserves to reflect real-time changes but are forced to rely on manual overrides and delayed integrations. This slows down decision-making and increases errors.

## Who is affected
- Sales teams, who have raised this issue in 3 mentions from 3 accounts [i:5388e3c55d08eb93][i:5d8a32853c6dd995][i:91bb9d5bd85ff69d].

## Evidence
- The problem has been mentioned 3 times by 3 accounts [i:5388e3c55d08eb93][i:5d8a32853c6dd995][i:91bb9d5bd85ff69d].
- All 3 mentions came via the sales route [i:5388e3c55d08eb93][i:5d8a32853c6dd995][i:91bb9d5bd85ff69d].
- One account, Quarrendon Commercial, requested a demo to see how a solution handles real-time reserves updates [i:5388e3c55d08eb93].
- Another account, Duncastle Auto, stated a need for smoother integrations and real-time updates [i:5d8a32853c6dd995].
- A third account, Brindlecombe Home, highlighted the need to ensure reserves reflect real-time changes without manual overrides [i:91bb9d5bd85ff69d].
- The total ARR from accounts mentioning this issue is 80000.0 GBP [i:5d8a32853c6dd995].
- 0 of these accounts are up for renewal in the next 90 days.

## Why now
- The most recent mention was on 2026-10-27 [i:5388e3c55d08eb93].
- The issue has been raised consistently over a six-week period, from 2026-09-15 to 2026-10-27 [i:91bb9d5bd85ff69d][i:5d8a32853c6dd995][i:5388e3c55d08eb93].
- One account with an ARR of 80000.0 GBP has a renewal date set for 2027-08-19 [i:5d8a32853c6dd995].",
  "citations": ["5388e3c55d08eb93", "5d8a32853c6dd995", "91bb9d5bd85ff69d"]
}
